```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
data("ny_noaa")

weather = ny_noaa |>
  filter(
    id == "USW00094728",
    date >= as.Date("2006-01-01"), date <= as.Date("2010-12-31")
  ) |>
  transmute(
    date,
    year = lubridate::year(date),
    month_number = lubridate::month(date),
    month_date = lubridate::floor_date(date, "month"),
    month = factor(month.abb[month_number], levels = month.abb),
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    precipitation = prcp / 10,
    snowfall = snow,
    season = factor(
      case_when(
        month_number %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
        month_number %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
        month_number %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
        TRUE ~ "Autumn"
      ),
      levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn")
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(date)

stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(weather$date),
  setequal(weather$date, seq(as.Date("2006-01-01"), as.Date("2010-12-31"), by = "day")),
  all(complete.cases(weather)),
  all(weather$tmax >= weather$tmin),
  all(weather$precipitation >= 0), all(weather$snowfall >= 0)
)

monthly_weather = weather |>
  group_by(month_date, month) |>
  summarize(
    mean_high = mean(tmax), mean_low = mean(tmin),
    total_precipitation = sum(precipitation), days = n(), .groups = "drop"
  )
precipitation_by_month = monthly_weather |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarize(
    mean_total = mean(total_precipitation), years = n(), .groups = "drop"
  )
season_colors = c(
  "Winter" = "#426987", "Spring" = "#668154",
  "Summer" = "#b26b36", "Autumn" = "#865e7f"
)
```

### Five years at one weather station

<div class="overview-text">

**Central Park, Manhattan** · January 1, 2006–December 31, 2010 · `r scales::comma(nrow(weather))` daily observations.

Explore the annual temperature cycle, compare precipitation across calendar months, and inspect individual days. All selected dates have temperature, precipitation and snowfall records. Hover over a plot for exact values; use its toolbar to zoom or reset.

</div>

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly mean high and low temperatures

```{r monthly-line}
monthly_temperature = monthly_weather |>
  select(month_date, mean_high, mean_low, days) |>
  pivot_longer(c(mean_high, mean_low), names_to = "measure", values_to = "temperature") |>
  mutate(
    measure = factor(measure, c("mean_high", "mean_low"), c("Daily high", "Daily low")),
    hover = paste0(
      format(month_date, "%B %Y"), "<br>", measure, ": ",
      sprintf("%.1f", temperature), " °C<br>", days, " observed days"
    )
  )

monthly_temperature |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month_date, y = ~temperature, color = ~measure,
    colors = c("#b26b36", "#426987"), type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
    text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text", line = list(width = 2)
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month", type = "date", tickformat = "%b<br>%Y"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Temperature (°C)", zeroline = FALSE),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.12),
    margin = list(l = 60, r = 20, b = 58, t = 30),
    font = list(family = "Arial", size = 12),
    paper_bgcolor = "#ffffff", plot_bgcolor = "#ffffff"
  ) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```

### Daily minimum and maximum temperatures

```{r temperature-scatter}
weather |>
  mutate(hover = paste0(
    format(date, "%b %d, %Y"), "<br>Low: ", sprintf("%.1f", tmin),
    " °C<br>High: ", sprintf("%.1f", tmax), " °C<br>Precipitation: ",
    sprintf("%.1f", precipitation), " mm"
  )) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~tmin, y = ~tmax, color = ~season, colors = season_colors,
    type = "scatter", mode = "markers", text = ~hover, hoverinfo = "text",
    marker = list(size = 6, opacity = 0.5)
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Daily minimum (°C)", zeroline = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum (°C)", zeroline = FALSE),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.12),
    margin = list(l = 60, r = 20, b = 58, t = 30),
    font = list(family = "Arial", size = 12)
  ) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```

### Average monthly precipitation

```{r precipitation-bar}
precipitation_by_month |>
  mutate(hover = paste0(
    month, "<br>Average monthly total: ", sprintf("%.1f", mean_total),
    " mm<br>", years, " monthly totals (2006–2010)"
  )) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~month, y = ~mean_total, type = "bar",
    marker = list(color = "#126b77"), text = ~hover,
    textposition = "none", hoverinfo = "text"
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Calendar month", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = month.abb),
    yaxis = list(title = "Precipitation (mm)", rangemode = "tozero"),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    margin = list(l = 60, r = 20, b = 58, t = 20),
    font = list(family = "Arial", size = 12)
  ) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```

### Daily high temperatures by season

```{r season-box}
weather |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~season, y = ~tmax, color = ~season, colors = season_colors,
    type = "box", boxpoints = FALSE, showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Season", categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = levels(weather$season)),
    yaxis = list(title = "Daily maximum (°C)", zeroline = FALSE),
    margin = list(l = 60, r = 20, b = 58, t = 20),
    font = list(family = "Arial", size = 12)
  ) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
```

### Reading the charts

The median daily high is `r sprintf("%.1f", median(weather$tmax[weather$season == "Summer"]))` °C in summer and `r sprintf("%.1f", median(weather$tmax[weather$season == "Winter"]))` °C in winter. The seasonal ranges still overlap. Boxes show the middle half of daily highs, with a line at the median; individual points are hidden.

Each precipitation bar averages **five monthly totals**, one from each year. The calendar month with the highest average total in this window is `r as.character(precipitation_by_month$month[which.max(precipitation_by_month$mean_total)])`, averaging `r round(max(precipitation_by_month$mean_total), 1)` mm.

These five years describe Central Park during this period. One station cannot represent all of New York or establish a long-term climate trend.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Data and methods

Source: [`p8105.datasets::ny_noaa`](https://p8105.com/dataset_noaa.html). Station `USW00094728` is identified as **NY CITY CNTRL PARK** in [NOAA's station inventory](https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/pub/data/ghcn/daily/ghcnd-stations.txt).

The dashboard loads data directly from the course package. Temperatures are converted from tenths of a degree Celsius to °C; precipitation is converted from tenths of a millimeter to mm. Snowfall is already in mm. No random sample is used. Winter is December–February, spring March–May, summer June–August and autumn September–November; winter days are grouped by calendar season rather than complete winter-years.
